notes.title: Adjustment + Ranking reset (v1.03a)
notes.content:
We made the following adjustments and [u][b]reset the leaderboard[/b][/u].
You can check the old ranking from Leaderboard in the main menu.
・Fixed so that the score can exceed 2.1 billion on the leaderboard.
・The maximum number of items on the screen has been increased from 1024 to 2048.
・We weakened some medium-sized aircraft.
・Improved the collection speed after an item enters the collection range
・The width of the rank graph has been expanded from 5 to 20.

notes.title: Fixed the problem that TOP10 is not displayed in LeaderBoard
notes.content: Fixed a problem with the LeaderBoard not displaying the Top 10

notes.title: Steam ranking (beta) is now supported.
notes.content:
[b]Steam ranking (beta) is now supported.[/b]
Upload your score when you complete a game.
You can check the top 10 and your ranking from the LeaderBoard on the main screen. This is a beta version, so there may be some bugs.
If you find any bugs, please contact the developer.


[b]Changed score calculation rate.[/b]
The calculation of the clear bonus is no longer rounded to the nearest 100 ranks.
The calculation of the clear bonus does not include remaining barriers (remaining aircraft) and remaining bombs.
The score for items along the way is now higher.

Higher ranks now score higher.
The ratio of score and clear bonus earned along the way has been roughly halved.
Please check the in-game Manual for details.

Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version)

notes.title: English is now supported
notes.content:
You can select the language from the startup menu or GameOption.
Please note that this is a machine translation, so the English may be incorrect.

notes.title: Bug fix I deleted it because it contained save data.
notes.content: You can delete the save data by right-clicking Epic Recovery from the game list, managing, and deleting GameData.dat from View local files.
